en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a cobblestone street with several people standing and walking near a whitewashed fountain structure built into a wall, under a large tree. A lamppost projects from the wall above the fountain. In the background are traditional buildings lining the street. The lower margin contains printed French text identifying the scene, and the name of the publisher in Lyon.
